summary: This is a GitLab CI job that runs phplint, a PHP syntax checker, inside a Docker container. It mounts the current project directory into the container and checks all PHP files for syntax errors.

explanations.2: Specifies which Docker image to use as the base environment for this job — in this case, Docker version 28.1.1.
explanations.4: Tells Docker where to find the socket (the communication pipe) for talking to the Docker daemon running on the host machine.
explanations.5: Disables TLS certificate verification for Docker, simplifying the setup for local CI environments.
explanations.7: Runs a PHP quality assurance tool (jakzal/phpqa) that checks the project for syntax errors; the --volume flag shares the project directory with the container, and --workdir sets /app as the working directory inside the container.
